nufenen-gotthard-tremola-furka-highline.title: Nufenen · Gotthard Tremola · Furka Highline
nufenen-gotthard-tremola-furka-highline.slogan: 3 passes in 202 km, topping out at 2478 m
nufenen-gotthard-tremola-furka-highline.story: High altitude, cobbles, hairpins and no room for lazy planning. Out of Andermatt and back again: 202 km, roughly 3 h 52 in the saddle. The climbs: Gotthard Tremola cobbles, Nufenenpass and Furka west. It tops out at 2,478 m. Gotthard Pass and Furka Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.

waypoints.name: Andermatt base check
waypoints.advice: Andermatt base check is where the day begins. Next is Gotthard Tremola cobbles, climbing 662 m.

waypoints.name: Gotthard Tremola cobbles
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2106 m here. The road climbs 662 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Airolo fuel and water, mostly downhill.

waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 2478 m up. The road climbs 1303 m on the way up to it, hard. Reckon on about 8 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Furka west ramp.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2106 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
